summary: Frontend-only validation of the Home 'AllTripsCarousel' redesign: new differentiated COPY, expanded descriptions, and a FromPrice block matching the catalog. All criteria pass on desktop & mobile with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AllTripsCarousel.jsx: large static TRIPS array (~120 lines) duplicates routeId/nights metadata already known to HomeAllTripsCatalog/programPricing — consider centralising the trip catalogue to avoid drift between catalog and carousel.

FromPrice popover trigger uses onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave + click; on touch devices without hover this still works because PopoverTrigger handles click — verified popover opens via click (URL unchanged). OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Carousel header verified: overline 'Explora y compara' (rendered uppercase by CSS), H2 'Desliza entre todas nuestras rutas', body mentions 'precio orientativo' + 'Desliza el carrusel'. Forbidden phrases ('Cada ruta, en detalle', 'Atajo directo a la ficha') absent. Card ad-4-5 description: 'Cruza el Alto Atlas por Tizi n'Tichka hasta las dunas doradas del Erg Chebbi…'. All 21 carousel cards expose data-testid all-trips-from-<id>; format identical to home catalog ('Desde €1240 por persona'). Hover opens breakdown popover (all-trips-from-ad-4-5-breakdown). Click on price does NOT navigate (URL unchanged). Arrows scroll the rail (scrollLeft 48 → 1140). Link all-trips-link-ad-4-5 href intact (/viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d). TripCardActions still rendered (8 nested testids). Home catalog 'home-all-trips' unchanged (search input present, FromPrice format identical). Mobile (390x844): card 304w, price visible at y≈642, no overflow.
